title: jsonl (one line)
description: DATA ROWS: one JSON object per line (a file whose whole text is one JSON array of objects is accepted too). This schema describes ONE LINE: a row, or a DIRECTIVE — a line whose keys all start with `$` — saying what is known about these rows.
x-studio-file: one JSON object per line; this schema describes a line

then.description: A directive line: what is known about the rows in this file. Several may be split across lines; `$labels` accumulates, a second scalar replaces the first.

$labels.description: Header names by field, dot paths included.

else.description: A row: any keys; every key becomes a column.
